 FIA podium intervention called for as Kimi Antonelli makes crazy decision – RacingNews365 Review
 Check out the biggest stories of the day with the RacingNews365 Review.
 Nick Golding
 11 November 10:00PM
 0 comments 
 0
 Add us as preferred source 
 Article 
 To news overview 
 © XPB Images
 David Coulthard has called on the FIA to review its podium safety procedures after Lando Norris once again smashed a champagne bottle against the floor during his São Paulo Grand Prix celebrations, warning that the McLaren driver was "very lucky" to escape injury.
 READ MORE: FIA called to intervene after Lando Norris injury near-miss: 'He's very lucky' 
 Kimi Antonelli hilariously makes radical hair change to celebrate F1 title
 Kimi Antonelli sprayed his hair in the colours of the Italian flag to celebrate becoming the nation's first F1 drivers' champion in 73 years, with the Mercedes driver showing off his new look to team-mate George Russell and boss Toto Wolff.
 READ MORE: Kimi Antonelli hilariously makes radical hair change to celebrate F1 title 
 © XPB Images
 Mick Schumacher makes surgery decision after year-long painful injury
 Mick Schumacher will head into his second IndyCar campaign without going under the knife, choosing to manage his left wrist problem through conservative treatment and physiotherapy rather than surgery.
 READ MORE: Mick Schumacher makes surgery decision after year-long painful injury 
 Max Verstappen handed Mercedes warning in 'egotistical' Lewis Hamilton take down
 Ralf Schumacher has questioned whether Max Verstappen would be a good fit for Mercedes, suggesting the Dutchman's hands-on approach could create difficulties within the team.
 READ MORE: Max Verstappen handed Mercedes warning in 'egotistical' Lewis Hamilton take down 
 Former senior Williams figure issues 'safe hands' confidence amid painful season
 Claire Williams has backed Williams to recover from a troubled 2026 campaign, insisting the team remains in "safe hands" under owner Dorilton Capital and team principal James Vowles.
 READ MORE: Former senior Williams figure issues 'safe hands' confidence amid painful season 
 Former Ferrari F1 hopeful completes 'demanding' Lola Formula E switch
 Former Ferrari junior driver Robert Shwartzman has signed for Lola as the team's first driver for the Gen4 era of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship.
 READ MORE: Former Ferrari F1 hopeful completes 'demanding' Lola Formula E switch 
 Also interesting:
 Join RacingNews365's Ian Parkes, Samuel Coop and Nick Golding as they look back on the São Paulo Grand Prix in Brazil! Max Verstappen’s simply staggering recovery from 21st on the grid is a key talking point, as is Ferrari’s current power unit struggles.
